events.text: Marie Antoinette is guillotined during the French Revolution.
Ether anaesthesia is demonstrated in public for the first time, at Massachusetts General Hospital.
Charlotte Brontë's novel Jane Eyre is published.
The Walt Disney Company is founded.
The Cuban Missile Crisis begins when Kennedy is shown photos of Soviet missiles in Cuba.
China tests its first atomic bomb.
Tommie Smith and John Carlos raise their fists in protest on the Olympic podium.
Karol Wojtyła is elected Pope John Paul II, the first non-Italian pope in over 400 years.

births.text: David Ben-Gurion, first Prime Minister of Israel
